# Nitro Forge

> Document studios on one Rust engine, with a shadcn registry (@nitro-forge) for the studio-workspace chrome, theme, provider and icons. Controls come from @nyc-tron. Nothing is on npm: the engines, ignition and studio-layout are monorepo packages at 0.0.0, and steps 1 to 3 of the install order cannot be reproduced outside this repo today. The `v0.1.0-agent-native` tag in these links is a placeholder until the owner publishes a release.

Start here: the provider prerequisite. Every studio component throws without StudioUIProvider (install studio-ui-provider and nyc-tron-host first). Install order has nine steps, numbered 0 to 8; a registry add covers steps 4 and 8 and the file parts of 5, 6 and 7.

## Install and rules

- [Install order](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/nitro-forge/v0.1.0-agent-native/docs/agent-native/install-order.md): The nine-step chain, which steps `shadcn add` covers, and the commands for the rest.
- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/nitro-forge/v0.1.0-agent-native/SKILL.md): Provider first, install order, rebrand contract, token rules, what is deferred and why.
- [Agent guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/nitro-forge/v0.1.0-agent-native/AGENTS.md): Contracts, commands and contributor rules, plus the agent-native section.
- [Not in the registry](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/nitro-forge/v0.1.0-agent-native/registry-excluded.json): Four deferred adapters, 12 engines, ignition and studio-layout, each with a reason.

## Needs StudioUIProvider (8)

- [Forge Document Stage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/nitro-forge/v0.1.0-agent-native/docs/components/forge-document-stage.md): Workspace chrome: read-only stage of live engine state (text, cells, slides, tracks, shapes). Needs StudioUIProvider and studio-layout.
- [Forge Workspace](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/nitro-forge/v0.1.0-agent-native/docs/components/forge-workspace.md): Workspace chrome: header, undo/redo toolbar, docks, floating panels, status line. Needs StudioUIProvider, @nyc-tron controls, studio-layout.
- [NYC-Tron Host](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/nitro-forge/v0.1.0-agent-native/docs/components/nyc-tron-host.md): Provider adapter: nycTronStudioUI() maps @nyc-tron controls onto the StudioUIProvider slots. Needs the @nyc-tron tarballs installed.
- [Persona Composer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/nitro-forge/v0.1.0-agent-native/docs/components/persona-composer.md): Persona form: name it, order instruments, pick capabilities, save, export, import. Needs StudioUIProvider and a PersonaStore.
- [Persona Turret](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/nitro-forge/v0.1.0-agent-native/docs/components/persona-turret.md): Persona switcher dial with four stops. Drag or arrows preview, Enter commits. Needs StudioUIProvider, studio-theme, forge-directions.
- [Prism Canvas](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/nitro-forge/v0.1.0-agent-native/docs/components/prism-canvas.md): Artboard: transparency checker, selection outline, one-finger drag to move bounds. Needs StudioUIProvider and studio-gesture.
- [Prism Editor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/nitro-forge/v0.1.0-agent-native/docs/components/prism-editor.md): Vector canvas editor: shape tools, layers panel, transforms, personas. Needs @nitro-forge/ignition first, StudioUIProvider, @nyc-tron.
- [Quill Text Editor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/nitro-forge/v0.1.0-agent-native/docs/components/quill-text-editor.md): Writing surface: draft applied as one edit, conflict on outside change. Needs StudioUIProvider and a Quill document with apply and reload.

## No provider needed (10)

- [Studio UI Provider](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/nitro-forge/v0.1.0-agent-native/docs/components/studio-ui-provider.md): Provider: StudioUIProvider supplies the 27 UI slots. Every studio component throws without it. Fill the slots with nyc-tron-host.
- [Studio Theme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/nitro-forge/v0.1.0-agent-native/docs/components/studio-theme.md): Theme: dark and light tokens, densities, generated theme.css (Tailwind v4) and theme.native.css (Uniwind). build:theme regenerates both.
- [Brand Theme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/nitro-forge/v0.1.0-agent-native/docs/components/brand-theme.md): Rebrand contract: brand.theme.json schema and a validator. A brand sets accent, ink and soft per scheme (3 keys). Neutrals, radius and status colours stay locked. Needs studio-theme.
- [Forge Directions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/nitro-forge/v0.1.0-agent-native/docs/components/forge-directions.md): Theme: workbench, optics and atelier palettes for Prism chrome and the persona turret, plus WCAG contrast helpers. Needs studio-theme.
- [Forge Icon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/nitro-forge/v0.1.0-agent-native/docs/components/forge-icon.md): Icon: outline when idle, filled when selected. 47 glyphs drawn; 42 of 1,463 catalog ids resolve to one; 6 drawn glyphs are not catalog ids. A name with no glyph renders nothing. Needs react-native-svg.
- [Forge Icon Button](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/nitro-forge/v0.1.0-agent-native/docs/components/forge-icon-button.md): Icon: pressable ForgeIcon with a 44 by 44 hit target. Throws TypeError on a blank label. Same file as forge-icon, so this item installs forge-icon. Needs react-native-svg.
- [Instrument System](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/nitro-forge/v0.1.0-agent-native/docs/components/instrument-system.md): Instrument policy, not UI: 18 blueprints, precision scrubbing math, ruler ticks, motion budgets, overlay planner. No provider needed.
- [Persona Model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/nitro-forge/v0.1.0-agent-native/docs/components/persona-model.md): Persona data, not UI: 4 personas, 11 capabilities, 7 surfaces, compose, import, export, per-document store. No provider needed.
- [Studio Gesture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/nitro-forge/v0.1.0-agent-native/docs/components/studio-gesture.md): Gesture primitive: one-finger pan recognizer, PanResponder on web, Gesture Handler on native. No provider needed.
- [Workspace Utilities](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikevocalz/nitro-forge/v0.1.0-agent-native/docs/components/workspace-utilities.md): Helpers, not UI: APP_MANIFESTS (task line, glyph, category per studio), jsonProblem (JSON parse error as a sentence). Needs studio-layout.
